description: Machine-readable index of the AINumbers ChainGraph suite. Every tool's MCP name, mandate_type, inputSchema pointer, and chain edges (consumes/feeds). Linked from llms.txt and embedded as JSON-LD on the hub. Internal mandate_type taxonomy — not AP2 v0.2 spec vocabulary.
suite_claim: Client-side, zero-egress, AP2-emitting decision tools with verifiable execution hashes — connective tissue for the agentic-finance stack.

nodes.description: Transforms any ChainGraph artifact JSON into a structured, regulator-framed prompt for any external LLM. Template registry v1.0.0 — one entry per mandate_type.
nodes.deadline_note: Chains into all tools — deploy first

nodes.description: Validates AP2 v0.2 Intent→Cart→Payment mandate trio: signature-chain integrity, scope/limit consistency, TTL/expiry, over-spend detection, Human-Not-Present flows. Publishes conformance test-vector fixtures.
Simulates thousands of synthetic agent transactions against a user-authored spend policy. Flags scope creep and policy-bypass paths. Covers AP2 v0.2 Human-Not-Present autonomous flows.

nodes.description: 1:1 reserve coverage, reserve-composition eligibility against GENIUS Act permitted-asset classes, monthly reserve-report figures against AICPA 2025 Criteria for CEO/CFO certification.

nodes.description: Takes incident parameters and returns the DORA Article 19/20 reporting determination plus the reporting clock. Deterministic, no GPU required.

nodes.description: Batch IBAN-name matching across synthetic payee records: match/close-match/no-match classification, configurable strictness, false-positive vs false-negative trade-off curves. Upgrades T289 to full ChainGraph schema.
